messages:
Sam Patel: FYI — ACME (enterprise) asked for an EU-only POC. They want tenant pinned to eu-west-1, BYO KMS, and a clear list of sub-processors. Can we run a quick presales checklist?
Priya Nair: Thanks Sam. Do we have a draft SLA / scope for a POC like this? Need to confirm retention + audit logs before pricing.
Miguel Torres: Region note: eu-west-1 capacity available on Dedicated, hosted has eu control plane with regional inference in eu-west-1/2. We can pin but need to confirm failover policy (no cross-border failover unless approved).
Lina Chen: Legal: ACME is asking for sub-processor attestation + SOC2 clause. We'll need the subproc export list (iso-coded) + an inaugural DPA addendum. Also confirm BYO KMS key wrapping flow and whether keys ever leave customer KMS.
Sam Patel: Good call. Customer also asked for cost delta for dedicated pinned vs hosted routed. Can someone rough out numbers?
Alex Rossi: I can do a quick cost sketch. Two bullet points: 1) Hosted with EU pinning (soft pin) — cheaper but possible transient failover to non-EU if capacity constrained; 2) Dedicated reserved GPU pool in eu-west-1 — higher commit, guaranteed locality. I'll post numbers later today.
Priya Nair: Tech Q for infra: for BYO KMS, do we support Envelope Encryption with customer AWS KMS + HSM? Also need to confirm whether we store any key material in our control plane.
Miguel Torres: We do envelope encryption. Customer CMKs stay in their KMS; Redwood holds only encrypted DEKs and does not persist plaintext keys. Control plane metadata references key ARN; we can include that in attestation.
Priya Nair: Perfect. Can we also provide the sub-processor list scoped to EU-only ops (which subprocessors would touch EU data)?
Miguel Torres: Short list: cloud provider (regional EU infra), monitoring vendor (EU data residency offering), analytics (aggregated only), and a managed logging vendor (EU retention). I'll export the current attested subproc list and mark which have EU-only contracts.
Lina Chen: Also request: export certs for each subproc (ISO/SOC3 links) + contact for Data Processing Addendum sign-off.
Sam Patel: Customer wants timeline: 2-week POC start to demo. We need a runbook for network peering, cert exchange, and test plan. Who owns the runbook?
Priya Nair: I'll own the runbook. Need Infra to confirm steps / required ACLs and ops ticket.
Miguel Torres: Will create an ops ticket. High-level steps: 1) Confirm tenancy and VPC peering details; 2) Exchange cert bundles; 3) Provide KMS key ARN and verify CMK policy; 4) Deploy POC model to dedicated pool; 5) Smoke test and latency checks.
ops-bot: Ticket created: RDW-1249 — "ACME EU POC: VPC peering + BYO KMS + subproc attestation" assigned to @miguel.t
Alex Rossi: Pricing note: For a 2-week POC we can offer a trial credit that covers baseline tokens+1 dev instance. Dedicated pinned baseline for demo: estimate €6k/week (includes reserved GPU + networking). Hosted soft-pin trial: negligible infra cost, but add egress/KMS ops fees ~€800/week. Will refine.
Priya Nair: Can we string together a short test matrix for the POC? Minimal acceptance criteria: 1) All requests originate and terminate in EU region, 2) Keys never leave customer's KMS, 3) 95th percentile latency under 200ms for 512 token gen, 4) audit logs accessible to ACME for the window.
Miguel Torres: Affirmative. For #1 we need to lock routing policy: {
  "routing_policy": "tenant_pin",
  "allowed_regions": ["eu-west-1"],
  "failover": "none_unless_approved"
}
Priya Nair: Good snippet — can we give that as a config example in the runbook? Also note the fallback handshake process if capacity is exceeded.
Lina Chen: I'll draft the contract language for the POC: addendum that forbids cross-border routing for the POC period and requires notification if failover occurs. Share with customer.
Sam Patel: Action items: Priya runbook owner; Miguel ops ticket & subproc list; Alex pricing sketch; Lina draft POC addendum. Can we aim for first draft by EOD tomorrow?
Everyone: +1
Priya Nair: One more — customer asked if we can provide a red-team/penetration scan report for the EU infra. Miguel, do we have a recent one?
Miguel Torres: Yes, we have a March 2025 infra pen test report with EU scope. I will attach summary and link to full report (internal).
Alex Rossi: I'll include the pricing delta in a simple table for the AE deck.
Sam Patel: I'll schedule a 30-min sync with ACME for Wednesday. Sending calendar invite after we have the runbook draft.
Priya Nair: Uploading initial runbook draft to the deal folder now -> /deals/ACME/poc/runbook.md (private).
Lina Chen: Added DPA checklist items to the deal doc.
Sam Patel: Thanks team — let's keep comms in this thread for audit. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Will ping once runbook has infra-specific ACLs.
Miguel Torres: Ops note: prepping certs and subproc export, ETA 24h.
Alex Rossi: ETA pricing numbers 6 hours.
ops-bot: RDW-1249 status updated -> "in progress"
Sam Patel: Closing loop — great pace.
